column1: prompt

Design and implement a distributed rate limiter in Python that works correctly across a cluster of API servers. Use Redis with Lua scripting to ensure atomicity, implement the sliding window log algorithm, handle Redis failover gracefully with a local fallback, and expose Prometheus metrics. Include a load test harness.

Implement a complete CQRS + event sourcing system in Python for an e-commerce order domain. Include: command handlers, event store (PostgreSQL), projections for read models, snapshot strategy after N events, event replay for rebuilding state, and an optimistic concurrency control mechanism.

Build a Python implementation of the Saga pattern for a distributed transaction spanning three microservices (order, payment, inventory). Implement both choreography and orchestration variants, handle partial failures with compensating transactions, and include a saga state machine with persistence.

Implement a complete transformer model from scratch in PyTorch (no Hugging Face): multi-head self-attention, positional encoding, encoder-decoder architecture, label smoothing loss, learning rate warmup schedule, and gradient clipping. Train on a toy sequence-to-sequence task and plot attention weights.

Build a production-grade ML feature store in Python: define features with transformations, support point-in-time correct lookups for training data (no data leakage), serve online features with Redis caching, track feature lineage, and expose a unified API for training and inference. Handle schema evolution.

Implement a Python bytecode interpreter for a subset of Python: support integers, booleans, arithmetic, comparison, if/else, while loops, function definitions, closures, and recursion. Parse bytecode from Python's dis module and execute it in your interpreter.

Build a Python library for declarative data pipelines: define pipeline stages as composable classes with typed inputs/outputs, support branching and merging data flows, detect cycles, execute stages in topological order with parallelism where possible, and provide visual graph rendering.

Implement a distributed consensus algorithm (Raft) in Python. Cover leader election, log replication, commitment, membership changes, and log compaction via snapshots. Build a key-value store on top of it and demonstrate correct behavior under network partition simulations.

Build a Python-based mTLS certificate lifecycle management system: generate CA and leaf certificates using cryptography library, auto-rotate before expiry, distribute via Vault or environment injection, validate chains on connection setup, and audit all certificate events. Include multi-environment support.

Design and implement a real-time bidding (RTB) auction engine in Python capable of processing 50,000 bid requests per second. Cover auction logic (second-price), budget pacing, frequency capping, creative validation, timeout handling (100ms max), and metrics collection. Include a benchmarking suite.

Implement a complete recommender system pipeline in Python: collaborative filtering (matrix factorization with SGD), content-based model using TF-IDF + cosine similarity, hybrid ensemble, online learning update mechanism, A/B testing infrastructure, and a Flask serving layer with latency SLOs.

Write a complete Kubernetes operator in Python using kopf that manages a custom CRD for a 'ManagedPostgres' resource. It should provision RDS instances via boto3, manage connection pooling via PgBouncer, handle upgrades, backups, and restore operations, and expose custom metrics to Prometheus.

Implement a Python async task queue from scratch (like a minimal Celery): define tasks with decorators, serialize to Redis, worker pool with configurable concurrency, task routing by type, priority queues, result backend, retry with backoff, task chaining, and a CLI for inspection.

Build a collaborative real-time code editor in TypeScript using Operational Transformation. Implement the server (Node.js + WebSocket), the OT algorithm for concurrent edits, client-side document model, undo/redo stack, cursor tracking across clients, and reconnection with state resync.

Design a multi-region active-active database replication system using PostgreSQL logical replication. Implement conflict detection and resolution (last-write-wins with vector clocks), automatic failover, lag monitoring, and a Python control plane that manages topology changes without downtime.

You are given a 200-line Python asyncio service that exhibits subtle race conditions: tasks occasionally see stale cache values, some WebSocket connections silently drop events under load, and the graceful shutdown occasionally hangs. Systematically diagnose using asyncio debugging tools, identify all issues, explain their root causes, and provide a fully corrected implementation.

Implement a complete online learning system for a click-through rate prediction model: process Kafka events, incrementally update a logistic regression model using mini-batch SGD, handle concept drift with a drift detector (ADWIN), shadow-deploy a new model variant, compare metrics, and promote automatically if performance improves.

Build a Python library for schemaless graph queries over a property graph stored in PostgreSQL (using recursive CTEs and JSONB). Support pattern matching (node-edge-node), path finding, aggregation over graph properties, and index recommendations based on query patterns.

Implement a Python-based workflow orchestration engine supporting: DAG definition via decorators, dependency resolution, parallel execution with worker pool, timeout and retry per task, dynamic task generation, state persistence with PostgreSQL, UI-ready event streaming via SSE, and a plugin system for custom executors.

Build a complete OAuth 2.0 authorization server in Python from scratch (no oauth2 libraries): implement authorization code flow with PKCE, device flow, token introspection, token revocation, refresh token rotation, rate limiting on token endpoints, and JWKS endpoint. Include a client management API.

Design and implement a complete search engine indexing pipeline in Python: crawl a set of URLs, parse HTML, extract and normalize text, compute TF-IDF scores, build an inverted index with positional data, persist to disk with efficient merge/compaction, and expose a query API supporting phrase search and boolean operators. Benchmark indexing and query throughput.

Build a Python implementation of a persistent B+ tree that stores key-value pairs on disk. Support: insertion with page splits, deletion with rebalancing, range scans, crash recovery using a write-ahead log, and an LRU buffer pool for page caching. Include correctness tests with random operations.

Implement a complete reinforcement learning system in Python using PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) from scratch. Train on CartPole and LunarLander environments. Include: actor-critic network architecture, generalized advantage estimation, clipped surrogate objective, value function loss, entropy bonus, parallel environment collection, and convergence plots.

Build a distributed key-value store in Python inspired by Dynamo: consistent hashing ring with virtual nodes, quorum reads/writes (R+W>N), vector clock versioning for conflict detection, Merkle tree anti-entropy for repair, gossip protocol for membership, hinted handoff for temporary node failures. Include a network simulation layer for testing.

Build a complete server-side rendering framework in TypeScript from scratch (minimal React SSR clone): component model with hooks (useState, useEffect), virtual DOM diffing and patching, SSR to HTML string, client-side hydration, streaming SSR support, and a simple router. Benchmark against baseline DOM manipulation.

Implement a log-structured merge tree (LSM tree) in Python: in-memory memtable with sorted writes, WAL for durability, flush to immutable SSTables on disk, multi-level compaction strategy (leveled), bloom filters per SSTable for read optimization, and snapshot-based iteration. Demonstrate insert/read/range-scan performance vs B-tree.

Build a production-quality Named Entity Recognition (NER) system in Python: fine-tune a transformer (DistilBERT) using BIO tagging, implement span extraction with confidence thresholds, build an active learning loop that queries for high-uncertainty examples, support incremental training on new entity types, and expose a gRPC inference API.

Design and implement a time-series database engine in Python: ingest sensor data at 100K points/second, compress using delta-of-delta + Gorilla floating point encoding, support time-range queries with downsampling aggregations (min/max/avg at multiple resolutions), handle out-of-order data, and implement a retention policy with automatic rollup.

Build a Python-based compiler for a simple statically-typed language: lexer (hand-written), recursive descent parser producing an AST, semantic analysis with type checking and scope resolution, IR generation, basic optimization (constant folding, dead code elimination), and code generation targeting x86-64 assembly. Include a test suite with 20+ programs.

Implement a complete Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline from scratch in Python: document ingestion with chunking strategies, embedding via sentence-transformers, FAISS vector index with hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval, reranking with a cross-encoder, context assembly with token budget management, LLM generation, and evaluation using RAGAS metrics. Include a self-query mechanism for structured filtering.

Build a complete event-driven microservices system in Python using FastAPI + Kafka: implement an Order Service, Payment Service, and Notification Service. Use the outbox pattern to guarantee at-least-once event delivery, implement idempotent consumers with deduplication, handle Kafka consumer group rebalancing gracefully, and include end-to-end integration tests using testcontainers.

Implement a complete Graph Neural Network from scratch in PyTorch for node classification on the Cora citation network. Cover: message passing framework, GraphSAGE and GAT variants, training with neighbor sampling for scalability, evaluation with masked splits, hyperparameter search with Optuna, and visualization of learned node embeddings with UMAP.

Build a Python implementation of a columnar storage format (minimal Parquet-like): encode each column separately with type-specific compression (dictionary encoding for strings, delta encoding for integers, RLE for repeated values), write row groups with metadata, support predicate pushdown to skip row groups during reads, and benchmark vs. row-oriented storage on analytical queries.

Implement a complete zero-trust security layer in Python for an internal microservices platform: mutual TLS with short-lived certificates (auto-rotated via Vault PKI), SPIFFE/SPIRE-inspired workload identity, per-service authorization policies evaluated at the sidecar layer, audit logging of all inter-service calls, and an admin API for policy management with GitOps-style PR-based approvals.

Design and build a complete workflow engine in Python inspired by Apache Airflow but minimalist: DAG definition via Python decorators, dependency resolution and cycle detection, parallel task execution using asyncio, task state persistence in PostgreSQL with at-least-once execution guarantee, retry with exponential backoff, dynamic task mapping (fan-out/fan-in), task timeout enforcement, and a REST API for triggering and monitoring runs.

Implement a complete multi-level cache system in Python: L1 in-memory LRU, L2 Redis with TTL, L3 database fallback. Support cache-aside and write-through strategies, cache stampede prevention using probabilistic early expiration, per-key TTL jitter, and Prometheus metrics for hit/miss/latency at each layer.

Design and implement a distributed job queue in Python using Redis. Support priority queues, job retries with exponential backoff, dead-letter queues, worker concurrency, and a monitoring endpoint that returns queue depth and worker status. Write the full implementation with tests.

Implement a multi-tenant feature flag system in Python. Each tenant has their own flag definitions, percentage rollout rules, and user-segment overrides. Flags are evaluated per-request with sub-millisecond latency using an in-memory cache with TTL-based invalidation backed by PostgreSQL.

Implement a concurrent web crawler in Python that respects robots.txt, rate-limits per domain, extracts and follows internal links up to depth N, detects and skips duplicate URLs using bloom filter, and stores results to SQLite. Must handle network errors, redirects, and malformed HTML gracefully.

Write a Python library that provides a typed, chainable query builder for PostgreSQL. Support SELECT with arbitrary WHERE clauses (and/or nesting), JOINs, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT/OFFSET, and parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection. Include comprehensive tests.

The following Python service handles webhook events from Stripe. Under high load it occasionally processes the same event twice, causing duplicate charges. Identify all concurrency and idempotency bugs, explain exactly why they occur, and rewrite the service with correct locking and deduplication.

The following React application has a memory leak that causes the browser tab to crash after 10 minutes of usage. The app uses WebSocket subscriptions, polling intervals, and a global event bus. Identify all leak sources with line-level explanations and provide fixed code.

Implement a real-time anomaly detection system in Python that trains an Isolation Forest on streaming data, retrains periodically when concept drift is detected (using ADWIN), serves predictions via a FastAPI endpoint, and logs anomalies to a time-series database. Include Docker setup.

Design and implement a Python ETL framework that supports parallel extraction from 5 heterogeneous sources (REST API, PostgreSQL, S3 CSV, Kafka topic, SFTP), applies configurable transformations, handles schema evolution, and loads into BigQuery with exactly-once semantics.

Build a GraphQL API in Python using Strawberry that serves a social network's feed. Implement cursor-based pagination, field-level authorization, N+1 query prevention using DataLoader, rate limiting per field, and a subscription resolver for real-time feed updates via WebSocket.

Write a Terraform module that provisions a production-grade ECS cluster: VPC with public/private subnets, ALB with HTTPS and WAF, ECS service with auto-scaling based on CPU and SQS queue depth, RDS Aurora with read replicas, and CloudWatch alarms with SNS notifications.

Implement a zero-trust API gateway in Python that validates mTLS client certificates, enforces per-route RBAC policies stored in OPA (Open Policy Agent), logs all decisions to an audit trail with tamper-evident hashing, and rate-limits per client certificate fingerprint.
